title: Kestrel and the Atlas
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Petra Villalobos, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
